scientific_goal: Test whether a reproducible, result-blind LEGSHOW_OBSERVED_LINE can be captured before prediction cutoff with sufficient annotation agreement to support future Rider×Line/Role research.

capture_population.selection: whole accessible meeting/day blocks selected before viewing any race result

source_priority: official/organizer public rider-introduction or legshow feed
organizer official live archive only if a pre-result-safe viewing mode/cut is available
other public permitted feed only after source classification audit
capture_contract: bind exact race_id and active field before annotation
record source URL and access timestamp JST
record source/video segment hash when technically available
annotator must not open result, payout, odds, forecast marks, candidate outputs or post-race review
annotate only formation visibly shown during rider introduction/legshow
if identity/order is not visually clear use UNKNOWN; never infer from region, style, forecast or later racing behavior

line_annotation_schema.line_state: ordered groups of car numbers, e.g. 7-4-1 | 2-5 | 6-3

independent_duplicate_annotation.independence: Annotator B cannot see Annotator A labels or candidate/model outputs before freezing B record.
independent_duplicate_annotation.adjudication: No forced consensus before agreement metrics; disagreements remain explicit.

transport_pass_requires: agreement and UNKNOWN rates reported without selective race removal
source provenance reproducible enough to re-audit
admission_rule.next_after_transport_pass: separate population/predictive prespec on new unseen races; never evaluate affinity on the transport pilot itself unless independently prespecified beforehand

failure_rule: If capture or agreement is weak, remain SOURCE_BLOCKED. Do not repair labels using result, provider narabiyoso, region/style heuristics, or post-race video.
